title: Rockstar says GTA 6 gameplay leaking "in this way has been heartbreaking", calling it "unfortunate" that the "game experience may now be impacted" by spoilers (John Walker/Kotaku)
summary: John Walker / Kotaku: Rockstar says GTA 6 gameplay leaking “in this way has been heartbreaking”, calling it “unfortunate” that the “game experience may now be impacted” by spoilers — The company also uncharacteristically apologizes for the lack of official information
contentText:
John Walker / Kotaku :

Rockstar says GTA 6 gameplay leaking “in this way has been heartbreaking”, calling it “unfortunate” that the “game experience may now be impacted” by spoilers   —  The company also uncharacteristically apologizes for the lack of official information
